correctness.rationale: Conditional centering and renewal reward theorem yield the exact diffusivity. For small theta the Mills bound makes H=theta F′-F positive. The Poisson bound follows from coefficientwise-positive hyperbolic series after a positive degree-six grouping. Source code replay gave 528 finite diagnostic assertions; global proof is analytical.
